source.title: 2017 European League Against Rheumatism/American College of Rheumatology classification criteria for adult and juvenile idiopathic inflammatory myopathies and their major subgroups
source.whyItFits: Open EULAR/ACR classification paper whose purpose is to separate idiopathic inflammatory myopathies and their subgroups, including polymyositis, dermatomyositis, and inclusion-body myositis.
